judge.rationale: The candidate only generated a definition-of-done file (`.lore/dod.md`), a brief update to `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, and a red acceptance test file (`src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts`). None of the actual production code changes were implemented: `src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, and `src/config.ts` are all untouched. Consequently, the new acceptance tests will fail immediately at runtime, and almost none of the ticket's acceptance criteria are met.
